chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mu'awiya, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When you intend to enter the state of Ihram at a time other than that of an obligatory prayer, pray two rak'ahs, then enter Ihram after them.

key_terms.إِحْرَام: Ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah

ai.seo_question: How to enter Ihram when it is not prayer time?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's al-Istibsar clarifies the procedural etiquette for entering Ihram outside of obligatory prayer times by prescribing two voluntary rak'ahs as a preparatory act. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the Sunnah of offering a specific prayer before the ritual consecration, ensuring spiritual readiness and distinguishing the act from mere physical transition. It reflects the broader principle of linking ritual states with acts of worship to enhance devotion.
